novel_mechanics_found: The upper cycling stack is relocatable even though the lower cycling stack is not: with the horizontal 6x3 helper at x=51..56, y=6..8, ACTION3 launched the upper 6x6 cycling stack left by 15 pixels from x=45..50 to x=30..35.
After that relocation, the vertical 3x6 helper at x=36..38, y=6..11 could launch the upper cycling stack left again through the color-15 partition, from x=30..35 into the plus chamber at x=15..20.
With the relocated upper stack overlapping the plus and its cycling phase returning to all-d, the plus was launched downward through the sealed horizontal partition from y=9..17 to y=21..29.

The horizontal helper can launch the vertical helper left until a color-2 barrier clamps it, and can launch it downward exactly 15 pixels through the lower color-15 partition into the vertical socket.
narrative: The required replay plan resolved to results/outer_loop_codex_ka59_probe.json. From a fresh env.reset(), all 358 labels were replayed live and frame_level(frame) was confirmed equal to 6 before any L7 probe. Direct frame-diff exploration then put the horizontal helper into its x=24..29, y=24..26 socket and used it to launch the vertical helper downward into its x=27..29, y=45..50 socket. To attack the plus chamber, I routed the horizontal helper through the three-row right-side gap and discovered that pushing the upper cycling stack left relocates it by 15 pixels, unlike the known-immovable lower stack. I then routed the vertical helper through the central three-column opening and used it to launch that relocated upper stack left through the color-15 wall into the plus chamber. Several live actions later, on the cycling stack phase transition, the plus moved downward through the sealed partition from y=9..17 to y=21..29. This was verified directly in the returned frame diff (45 color-11 pixels moved). While routing the horizontal helper below the displaced plus to seek the second downward launch, the level action/life counter reached zero: step 559 returned GAME_OVER and step 560 was an inert final call. No level advance occurred, so max_level_reached remains 6 and reproduction_verified is false.
gotchas: The 358-step mandatory prefix consumes more than half of the 700-call budget; this run used 202 additional calls and stayed under budget at 560 total.

The level has a visible action/life counter that reached zero before the 700-call external budget; a GAME_OVER frame has an empty grid and levels_completed resets to zero. The maximum observed before that terminal frame was retained as 6.
Only the 6x3 horizontal helper fits through the three-row horizontal gaps. The 3x6 vertical helper instead uses the three-column central opening.
Color-2 barriers clamp helper-to-helper horizontal launches; color-15 partitions permit the useful ballistic crossings.

Moving the upper stack into the plus chamber appears irreversible from the explored state. The next round should reproduce only the successful tail, time the all-d phase deliberately, and conserve the level counter for the second plus launch.
The action_sequence includes the terminal GAME_OVER-producing action and one inert post-GAME_OVER action because both were real env.step calls and are included in total_env_steps_used.
